title: Build the Message
goal: By the end of this lesson, you can turn short answers into complete messages, distinguish S+V (action) from S+BE (information), and use -s/-es correctly with he/she/it.

items.def: to have a job in the sales department

examples.text: She works in sales.
I work in sales for a tech company.

items.def: to do your job at home

examples.text: He works from home three days a week.
I work from home on Fridays.

items.vi: xử lý cuộc gọi khách hàng
items.def: to manage phone calls from customers

examples.text: She handles client calls every day.
He handles most of our client calls.
He supports the whole team.
We support each other in our team.
They need regular updates on the project.
My manager needs regular updates.

items.def: to have conversations after finishing work

examples.text: We usually talk after work.
They talk after work at the coffee shop.

items.vi: dùng tiếng Anh trong công việc
items.def: to communicate in English during work

examples.text: I use English at work every day.
She uses English at work with international clients.

items.def: someone who is approachable and friendly

examples.text: She's very easy to talk to.
My manager is easy to talk to.
He's very good with clients.

items.def: to have many tasks this week

examples.text: They're busy this week.

vocab.text: Choose two people. Say who they are and one thing you like or dislike about them. Accept simple language — ask one follow-up: How do you know them? or What are they like?

grammar.text: S+V vs S+BE — two ways to say a complete thought
Put your hand on your throat. If it vibrates → /z/. If not → /s/. If the word ends in a sibilant sound → /ɪz/.

reading.text: I work with a woman named Anna. She's our sales coordinator, and she's very easy to talk to. She works from home three days a week, but she comes to the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. She handles most of our client calls and gives the team regular updates. She's usually busy in the morning, but she's free after lunch. We work closely together, and she always supports the team when we need help.
Notice: she's + adjective/noun, she + verb-s. These are natural ways to describe people.

conversations.title: New client · introduce a colleague
conversations.target: Is she…? · Does she…? → full message

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she the person in charge of this project?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is. She's our sales coordinator.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does she handle client calls?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she does. She handles most client calls.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she available this afternoon?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is. She's free after two.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So can I introduce her?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Anna is our sales coordinator. She handles client calls and she's free after two.

check: Is Anna in charge of the project?
conversations.answers: 1. Yes, sales coordinator. 2. Yes. 3. After two.
conversations.note: Notice: question → short answer → full message → introduction.

conversations.title: Foreign partner · a close friend

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does he speak English?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, he does. He uses English at work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is he easy to talk to?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, he is. He's very friendly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does he live near us?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, he doesn't. He lives near the beach.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What should I know before we meet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Minh is friendly, uses English at work, and lives near the beach.

check: Is he easy to talk to?
conversations.answers: 1. Yes, at work. 2. Yes, friendly. 3. No, near the beach.
conversations.note: Notice: language → personality → place → complete picture.

conversations.title: Team update · recommend someone
conversations.target: Is she free…? · Does she work well…?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she free this week?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is. She's free from Wednesday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does she work well with new clients?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she does. She's very good with clients.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she familiar with this project?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is. She already supports the project team.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should we recommend her?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: She's available, good with clients, and familiar with the project.

conversations.note: Notice: availability → ability → project knowledge → recommendation.

listening.text: Shadowing · Nghe từng câu rồi nhắc lại
Bấm 🔊 để nghe từng câu, sau đó nhắc lại y hệt ngữ điệu. Làm 2 lượt: lượt 1 nhìn chữ, lượt 2 che chữ.

exercises.text: Bài tập 1 · Chọn dạng động từ đúng
Đáp án: 1 works · 2 handles · 3 work · 4 is · 5 is · 6 are. Quy tắc: he/she/it → V-s/es, we/they → V1.
Bài tập 2 · Short answer → full message

items.q: Does she work in sales? → Yes, she does. → Full message?
Is he your manager? → Yes, he is. → Full message?
Do they work from home? → No, they don't. → Full message?

exercises.text: Đáp án: 1 She works in sales. 2 He's my manager. 3 They work at the office. Quy tắc: short answer → full message, đúng engine.

speaking.text: Work with a partner. Ask 5 Yes-No questions about people you know. Answer with short answers, then say the full message.

items: Does she work in sales? → Yes, she does. → She works in sales.
Is he your manager? → Yes, he is. → He's my manager.
Do they work from home? → No, they don't. → They work at the office.
Is she busy today? → No, she isn't. → She's free this afternoon.
Does he handle client calls? → Yes, he does. → He handles client calls.

speaking.text: Use: Does he/she…? Is he/she…? Do they…? Are they…? Answer with short answer → full message.

roleplay.title: Mission 1 · New client
roleplay.context: Khách hàng sẽ làm việc với đồng nghiệp của bạn và muốn biết người đó là ai.
steps: Opener: Is she the person in charge of this project?
Hỏi 4+ Yes–No, ghi keywords không ghi nguyên câu.
Report: He/She is… · works… · usually… · is at/in…
roleplay.useful: Does she handle client calls? · Is she available this afternoon?

roleplay.title: Mission 2 · Foreign partner
roleplay.context: Người yêu nước ngoài sắp gặp bạn thân của bạn lần đầu.
steps: Thu thập: work · personality · interests · place
Giới thiệu 45 giây bằng full messages, không short answers.
roleplay.useful: Is he easy to talk to? · Does he live near us?

roleplay.title: Mission 3 · Team update
roleplay.context: Sếp hỏi ai có thể phụ trách khách hàng mới tuần này.
steps: Opener: Is she free this week?
roleplay.useful: Does she work well with new clients? · Is she familiar with this project?

finalTask.text: Work with a partner. Have a 3-minute conversation about people you know. Use DOES/IS/DO/ARE questions, answer with short answers, then say the full message.
Goal: 10+ questions, 10+ short answers, 10+ full messages. Notice when you use DOES vs IS.
